description: Mobile-only (Android + iOS) capabilities for Corvux. Holds the permissions for the mobile-only plugins: tauri-plugin-saf (Android Storage Access Framework folder picker + document ops), tauri-plugin-multicast-lock (Android WifiManager.MulticastLock for mDNS sync discovery), and tauri-plugin-ios-picker (iOS UIDocumentPicker + security-scoped bookmarks). These plugins are registered on all platforms (desktop builds get no-op stubs), but only mobile actually invokes them — so they're scoped here instead of the cross-platform default capability. Audit 2026-06-08, LOW-10.
